# knowledgesidekick.org — agent index
# Open, not-for-profit. Research, standards, adoption of knowledge-first practice
# for agentic AI, LLMs, and personal assistants.
# Updated: 2026-09-24.

## What this site is
A small, flat, not-for-profit site about knowledge as a first-class layer in agentic systems.
Written for technical leaders funding or building agentic AI, LLMs, and personal assistants.
Same ideas as https://knowledgesidekick.com, open side.

## Agent-oriented pages (new)
- A2A — agent-to-agent communication, standards, and knowledge exchange: https://knowledgesidekick.org/a2a/
- Agents — knowledge layer for agentic systems: forms, lifecycle, grounding: https://knowledgesidekick.org/agents/
- MCP — knowledge as a Model Context Protocol resource (knowledge servers, tool-backed knowledge): https://knowledgesidekick.org/mcp/
- llms.txt — machine-readable site index for LLMs and agents: https://knowledgesidekick.org/llms.txt (this file)
- agents.md — structured index for agent frameworks and crawlers: https://knowledgesidekick.org/agents.md

## Standards and conventions covered
- Knowledge representation (entities, facts, procedures, policies, relationships)
- Knowledge lifecycle (creation, representation, extraction, updates, deprecation)
- Grounding (claims tied to retrievable, current, permitted knowledge)
- The agent interface (clean documented surface for agent engines)
- Discoverability for agent engines (AEO / Agent Engine Optimization; llms.txt)
